theme-01.title: Hero headline and Explore banks button are not centered in the top block
theme-01.original_pinpoint: On the home page top block, spacing above the hero headline and below the Explore banks button is uneven, so the headline and button do not feel centered.

theme-02.title: Homepage sentences are too heavy, or they add nothing
theme-02.original_pinpoint: Story and supporting sentences on the home page (and later quoted site lines) use too many words, extra clauses, overlapping phrases, or empty support — they want simple polished English, and they also called the table-footer freshness line not correct English.

theme-03.title: Zero block on scroll looks broken
theme-03.original_pinpoint: On the homepage Zero commissions / Zero bias block, scrolling first shows two bare zeros (and later the section’s color fades away), so the block looks broken until the rest of the heading appears.

theme-04.title: “Zero commissions” mixes bank and customer, so the words are unclear
theme-04.original_pinpoint: On the homepage Zero block, “Zero commissions” is easy to read as a customer fee of zero, “Zero bias” switches to not pushing a bank, and the small supporting line is too small and does not say the fair-view / ranking-not-for-sale gist.

theme-05.title: Homepage story uses too many thin full-screen slides
theme-05.original_pinpoint: On the homepage, stacked full-screen story slides are too many and too thin — they repeat a quality already said, bury unique points across later sections, and should be consolidated so the homepage does not get longer.

theme-06.title: Built around you does not show the real product
theme-06.original_pinpoint: On the homepage Built around you / standardized-view stretch, the accordion only shows one line at a time, the side card duplicates that copy instead of the real product, and the “one standardized view” claim is not shown as a product you can see.

theme-07.title: Help strip sits off the footer, and the footer disclaimer washes its hands
theme-07.original_pinpoint: At the bottom of the homepage, the help strip sits in a padded gap instead of on the footer, and the footer Disclaimer reads as a nobody-cares legal block whose tone is “we are not responsible,” unlike the rest of the site standing with the customer.

theme-08.title: Explore banks filters are exclusive buttons and do not explain the choice
theme-08.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks Filters, Bank type / Rate / Facility are exclusive one-at-a-time buttons instead of checkboxes both on, and the labels do not explain the trade-offs or what Overdraft is, so a customer cannot tell what to select.

theme-09.title: Concessions Learn more takes you off the filter, and the page has no Back
theme-09.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, Concessions Learn more leaves the filter instead of explaining each option there, and the concessions Guide page has no Back.

theme-10.title: Loan-input helpers start with “Sets” and the property name is too complex
theme-10.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks Loan inputs, the Monthly income and Property helpers start with “Sets” (and “ceiling,” which they said India does not know) instead of saying why the number is asked, and the label “Property agreement value” is too complex for the box.

theme-11.title: CIBIL is one exact number, so the table can only show one rate
theme-11.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, CIBIL is a required exact number instead of a range or dropdown of score windows, and the bank table then shows only one Rate for a CIBIL band, so they cannot tell which rate applies.

theme-12.title: Explore banks lists today’s banks but does not give the hacks
theme-12.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, the form and bank table only return today’s offer for typed numbers; the missing layer is hacks/intelligence (what to change to save money, top-three optimizations, first-land averages then advice then the list), and linked fields do not carry the first inputs or show ROI first.

theme-13.title: Extra eligibility sits behind Adjust eligibility instead of as columns
theme-13.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, extra eligibility questions sit behind Adjust eligibility instead of as visible columns, look optional (or unopenable), still change the loan, and Co-applicant Yes coaches adding someone to inflate the amount.

theme-14.title: “See options” and “Explore banks” are the wrong names, and the button sits in the wrong place
theme-14.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, the primary action is labeled See options (unclear) instead of Compare banks, the page name Explore banks does not mean compare, and See options sits to the right of Adjust eligibility instead of below it in the center.

theme-15.title: The loan form does not show which fields matter most
theme-15.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, Loan inputs fields have no mark of how much each one matters (stars, meter, score, order, color), so filling the form does not teach importance, and the (i) tooltips need arranging.

theme-16.title: The page says banks, but the list is lenders
theme-16.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, chrome still says banks while the list is lenders including NBFCs; they asked where to use the neutral word lenders, then said to put lenders everywhere instead of banks.

theme-17.title: Results tabs sit too far from the table, and Apply once is not on the checkboxes
theme-17.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks results, the gap between the Overview/Charges tabs and the Lenders table is too large, and Apply once sits on the tab bar instead of on top of the row checkboxes.

theme-18.title: Results need a clear edit/clear button, and there is no search for a named bank
theme-18.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, returning to the loan form after Edit and wiping a filled eligibility card have no clear button, and the bank list has no in-page search for a named bank such as SBI.

theme-19.title: Scheme names live in More details, not in the product
theme-19.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, scheme identity (name and facts, including two schemes of the same bank) sits in a More details dump with a confusing More-about-the-bank cue, instead of in the product table where a customer can see and choose.

theme-20.title: Charges and calculations do not explain themselves
theme-20.original_pinpoint: On Explore banks, exact rates and charge notes do not explain themselves in plain language or rupees — missing stars, unlabeled how-calculated steps, legal jargon, footnote marks that look like links, duplicated government charges, and no extra-money math or highest-fee labels.

How is the cover set up?
The written details are found on your Policy Schedule.
House address                 The address on the policy must match the house.

Cover amount                 Check the cover amount before you sign. It should match rebuild cost of the structure, not market price of flat plus land. Deadline to file                 Within 90 days of the bank’s last reply, or of the day the 30-day wait ended if there was no reply. Use whichever date is later.
Before you file                 Incomplete, anonymous, or suggestion-only complaints are rejected. So is a request beyond what the Ombudsman can grant.
Online                 File through RBI CMS. Keep the complaint number.
Email or post                 Send the complaint to CRPC by email or by post.
Helpline                 Explains the process. Does not register the complaint.
